admit_only_when: the source identity and immutable version are known
reuse rights and required attribution are recorded
the spatial and temporal scope are inspectable
the source can be reproduced or retrieved through a stable connector
the source does not silently replace a failed preferred source
never_infer: population trend from changing record volume
local suitability from a donor model that failed its transfer gates
